description: Opens the database to the internet at its public host and port (IPv4 and IPv6, TLS and password still required), or closes it. sources restricts who may connect (IPv4/IPv6 addresses or ranges); omitted it is left as is, null or [] means everyone. Prefer listing the user's addresses. Live within about 30 seconds. Scope: network.write.

database.description: Database id, as returned by list_databases or create_database.

name: set_database_public_access
title: Set public access
